# Aura3D

> Aura3D 5.7.1: the complete TypeScript engine for browser games and 3D apps. You write a typed, declarative scene with `@aura3d/engine`; the `@aura3d/cli` toolchain handles typed assets, AI generation, checks and deploy gates. Built for AI coding agents. Site: https://aura3d.auraone.ai

Install: `npx create-aura3d@latest my-scene` or `npm i -E @aura3d/engine@5.7.1` (MIT, free).

## Aura3D vs three.js

three.js is a rendering library; Aura3D is the complete engine. Built in: WebGPU with WebGL2 fallback on one scene, `looks.preset` lighting, typed hashed GLBs (`model(assets.x)`), AI models and motion (`assets generate`, `animation generate`), `assets convert`, a game kit (`createGame`, Rapier, touch, audio, `?autoplay=1`), worker rendering, `check-deploy`. A lit, framed product is 10 lines vs 38. Porting: `aura3d migrate three`. https://aura3d.auraone.ai/docs/aura3d-vs-threejs

## Explore Aura3D

- [Start a TypeScript project](https://aura3d.auraone.ai/docs/agent-quickstart) with a working scene and development server.
- [Ember Courier](https://aura3d.auraone.ai/apps/ember-courier/). Playable courier character.
- [Vesper GT](https://aura3d.auraone.ai/apps/vesper-gt/). Grand tourer in a lighting studio.
- [Relay Workcell](https://aura3d.auraone.ai/apps/relay-workcell/). Robot pick-and-place cycle.
- [Play the 30 games](https://aura3d.auraone.ai/apps/showcase-index/); each guide links its source.

## First screen: Aura3D patterns (copy the shape, change the subject)

`@aura3d/engine` is installed; never open `node_modules` or `dist`. Blocks are typechecked, GPU-rendered patterns, not finished scenes: change subject and numbers; typecheck once. `createAuraApp(selector, { scene })` owns renderer, resize and loop. Vectors `[x, y, z]`, colours CSS strings, primitives are unit shapes scaled by `size`. Per frame `app.onFrame((f) => ...)` gives `f.dt`, `f.time` in seconds. To change a node later give it `.runtime({ id, mutable: true })`, then `app.nodes.require(id).setPosition(x, y, z)`.

### Scene skeleton: look, subject, ground, framed camera, per-frame update
```ts render=animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, looks, material, primitives, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
const app = createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene().add(looks.preset("product-studio", { exposureEv: -1.2 }))
    .add(primitives.plane({ name: "floor", size: [12, 1, 12], material: material.pbr({ color: "#d8dadf", roughness: 0.9 }) }))
    .add(primitives.sphere({ name: "orb", size: 1.6, material: material.pbr({ color: "#d9534f", roughness: 0.4 }) }).position(0, 0.8, 0).runtime({ id: "orb", mutable: true }))
    .camera(camera.auto({ fill: 0.5 })),
  ...looks.appOptions("product-studio")
});
app.onFrame((f) => app.nodes.require("orb").setPosition(0, 0.8 + 0.5 * Math.abs(Math.sin(f.time * 1.7)), 0));
void app.ready();
```
Gotchas: never `await app.ready()` at module top level: a production build deadlocks on it (black page); use `void app.ready()` or `app.ready().then(...)`. Never hand-place the camera. `camera.auto()` frames what the scene holds so the subject fills `fill` (default 0.6) of the frame, ground planes and `floor`/`ground`/`wall`-named nodes left out; `camera.auto({ subject: "clock", angle: "front", fill: 0.8 })` frames one named node or group with the props still in shot. A moving subject: `app.camera?.setPose(camera.framePose(box, { azimuth, fill, aspect }))` each frame. A look brings light, shadow, fog, sky and grade; spread `looks.appOptions(id)` with it (`outdoor-day`, `night-city`, `golden-hour`, `overcast`, `space`). `camera.perspective` is fixed, `camera.orbit` adds drag. Bright looks wash out: `looks.preset(id, { exposureEv: -1 })`. Colours take any CSS form (`#rrggbb`, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, names); an invalid one throws `COLOR_INVALID`. Hand-built light needs `environments.neutral({ intensity: 0.6, background: false })` beside `lights.key({ target })` (a directional key that casts a clean shadow; put a `primitives.plane` ground under the subject to catch it), else the frame is flat and dark and metals reflect nothing; `primitives.plane` size is `[w, 1, d]`. Glow: `effects.bloom({ intensity: 0.5, threshold: 0.8, radius: 0.5 })`.

### Instancing: many copies, one draw, updated live
```ts render=animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, looks, material, instances, scene, type AuraTransformSpec } from "@aura3d/engine";
const PAL = ["#e4572e", "#f3a712", "#a8c686", "#29a0b1", "#669bbc", "#9a5fb4"];
const N = 12, at = (i: number, t: number): AuraTransformSpec => {
  const x = (i % N) - 6, z = Math.floor(i / N) - 6, h = 0.7 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t + Math.hypot(x, z));
  return { position: [x, h / 2, z], scale: [0.8, h, 0.8] };
};
const cells = Array.from({ length: N * N }, (_, i) => at(i, 0));
const colors = cells.map((_, i) => PAL[(i % N + Math.floor(i / N)) % 6]!);
const app = createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene().add(looks.preset("outdoor-day", { exposureEv: -1 }))
    .add(instances.box({ name: "tiles", transforms: cells, colors, material: material.pbr({ color: "#ffffff" }) }).runtime({ id: "tiles", mutable: true }))
    .camera(camera.auto({ elevation: 0.7, fill: 0.8 })),
  ...looks.appOptions("outdoor-day")
});
app.onFrame((f) => app.nodes.require("tiles").setInstances(cells.map((_, i) => at(i, f.time * 1.3)), colors));
```
Gotchas: `instances.box|sphere|cylinder|cone|model`; `setInstances(transforms, colors)` animates, thousands are fine; pass the colours every call or they reset to the base colour.

### Custom shader: your own time uniform
```ts render=animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, material, primitives, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
const plasma = material.custom({
  glsl: {
    vertex: `out vec3 vP; void main() { vP = position; gl_Position = modelViewProjectionMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }`,
    fragment: `in vec3 vP; out vec4 outColor;
void main() {
  float w = sin(vP.x * 9.0 + clk) + sin(vP.y * 11.0 - clk * 1.3);
  outColor = vec4(0.5 + 0.5 * cos(w + vec3(0.0, 2.1, 4.2)), 1.0);
}`
  },
  uniforms: { clk: { type: "f32", value: 0 } }
});
const app = createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene({ background: "#0b0d14" }).add(primitives.sphere({ name: "blob", size: 2, material: plasma }).runtime({ id: "blob", mutable: true }))
    .camera(camera.perspective({ position: [0, 0.4, 4], target: [0, 0, 0], fov: 40 }))
});
app.onFrame((f) => app.nodes.require("blob").setUniform?.("clk", f.time));
```
Gotchas: GLSL 3.00 (`in`/`out`, declare your own `out vec4 outColor`). Prelude, never declare: `position normal uv modelViewProjectionMatrix modelMatrix cameraPosition`. On 5.0.x `uTime` does not advance by itself: declare a uniform and push it with `setUniform` every frame on a `.runtime({ id, mutable: true })` node, or the shader is frozen. A compile error logs `CUSTOM_SHADER_COMPILE_FAILED` and skips the draw.

### Procedural geometry: revolve a profile
```ts render=static
import { camera, createAuraApp, geometry, looks, material, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
const R = 32, S = 20, positions = new Float32Array((R + 1) * (S + 1) * 3), indices: number[] = [];
for (let j = 0; j <= S; j += 1) for (let i = 0; i <= R; i += 1) {
  const y = j / S, r = 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(y * Math.PI) , a = (i / R) * Math.PI * 2;
  positions.set([Math.cos(a) * r, y * 1.6, Math.sin(a) * r], (j * (R + 1) + i) * 3);
  if (i < R && j < S) { const v = j * (R + 1) + i; indices.push(v, v + 1, v + R + 1, v + 1, v + R + 2, v + R + 1); }
}
const geo = geometry.define({ positions, normals: geometry.computeNormals({ positions, indices }), indices, bounds: { min: [-0.7, 0, -0.7], max: [0.7, 1.6, 0.7] } });
createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene().add(looks.preset("product-studio", { exposureEv: -1.2 }))
    .add(geometry.custom(geo, { name: "vase", material: material.pbr({ color: "#c58b5a", roughness: 0.5 }) }))
    .camera(camera.auto({ fill: 0.8 })),
  ...looks.appOptions("product-studio")
});
```
Gotchas: `geometry.define({ positions, normals, indices, bounds, colors?, uvs? })` takes typed arrays, `indices: number[]` and `bounds`. Counter-clockwise triangles face out.

### Rigged model: clips and crossfade
```ts render=asset:animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, defineModelAssets, looks, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
const assets = defineModelAssets(
  { hero: { url: "/assets/hero.glb", sha256: "<64 hex of the file>", animations: ["Idle", "Walking"], license: "fixture" } },
  { queryParam: null }
);
const app = createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene().add(looks.preset("character-showcase"))
    .add(assets.node("hero", { name: "hero", targetHeight: 1.8 }).animate({ clip: "Idle", loop: true }).runtime({ id: "hero" }))
    .camera(camera.perspective({ position: [0, 1.3, 4.5], target: [0, 0.9, 0], fov: 40 })),
  ...looks.appOptions("character-showcase")
});
window.addEventListener("keydown", () => app.nodes.require("hero").play("Walking", { loop: true, crossFade: 0.4 }));
void app.ready();
```
Gotchas: clip names come from the file (`npx @aura3d/cli@latest assets inspect <file> --animation`). In a CLI project use `model(assets.hero)` after `assets resolve`. One skinned body per character: never animate primitives beside it.

### Game loop and input: fixed step, actions
```ts render=animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, createFixedStepLoop, looks, material, primitives, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
const app = createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene().add(looks.preset("arena-fight"))
    .add(primitives.box({ name: "player", size: 1.4, material: material.pbr({ color: "#4aa3ff" }) }).position(0, 0.7, 0).runtime({ id: "player", mutable: true }))
    .add(primitives.plane({ name: "floor", size: [14, 1, 14], material: material.pbr({ color: "#3b4350" }) }))
    .camera(camera.perspective({ position: [0, 4, 6], target: [0, 0.5, 0], fov: 45 })),
  ...looks.appOptions("arena-fight")
});
const input = app.input({ actions: { left: ["ArrowLeft", "KeyA"], right: ["ArrowRight", "KeyD"] } });
const state = { x: 0, t: 0 };
createFixedStepLoop({ stepSeconds: 1 / 60, step: (dt) => {
  input.update(dt); state.t += dt;
  state.x += ((input.held("right") ? 1 : 0) - (input.held("left") ? 1 : 0)) * 4 * dt;
}, render: () => app.nodes.require("player").setPosition(state.x, 0.7, 0).setRotation(0, state.t * 3, 0) }).start();
void app.ready();
```
Gotchas: simulate in `step` (no `Date.now`, no `Math.random`), copy state to nodes in `render`. Restart by resetting state and nodes, not `app.setScene`. Full games (`createGame`: pause, touch, results): `docs/agents/build-a-game.md`.

### Physics: bound bodies stepped in onFrame
```ts render=animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, looks, material, primitives, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
const balls = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => primitives.sphere({ name: `b${i}`, size: 0.5, material: material.pbr({ color: ["#e4572e", "#f3a712", "#29a0b1", "#9a5fb4"][i]! }) })
  .position((i % 3) * 0.3 - 0.3, 2 + i * 1.2, (i % 2) * 0.2).runtime({ id: `b${i}`, mutable: true })
  .physics({ type: "dynamic", shape: "sphere", radius: 0.25, mass: 1, restitution: 0.5 }));
const app = createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: balls.reduce((s, b) => s.add(b), scene().add(looks.preset("outdoor-day", { exposureEv: -1 }))
    .add(primitives.box({ name: "floor", size: [6, 0.2, 6], material: material.pbr({ color: "#7a8470" }) }).runtime({ id: "floor" }).physics({ type: "static", shape: "box", halfExtents: [3, 0.1, 3] })))
    .camera(camera.perspective({ position: [4, 3, 6], target: [0, 1.5, 0], fov: 40 })),
  physics: { bindNodes: true }, ...looks.appOptions("outdoor-day")
});
app.onFrame((f) => { app.physics.step(f.dt); });
void app.ready();
```
Gotchas: needs the optional peer `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat` installed (scaffolds have it), else the page throws. Pass `physics: { bindNodes: true }`, give each body `.runtime({ id })`, call `app.physics.step(dt)` once per frame. Colliders take radius or half extents, not the primitive `size`.

### Particles: built-in sprites, no art needed
```ts render=animated
import { camera, createAuraApp, effects, environments, material, primitives, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene({ background: "#080b14" }).add(environments.neutral({ intensity: 0.2, background: false }))
    .add(primitives.plane({ name: "ground", size: [12, 1, 12], material: material.pbr({ color: "#242a36", roughness: 1 }) }))
    .add(effects.particles({ name: "fountain", position: [0, 0.2, 0], rate: 90, maxParticles: 400, lifetime: [1.2, 1.8], speed: [3, 4.5], size: [0.12, 0.22], gravity: 6, drag: 0.1, blend: "additive", seed: 7, color: "#6fc8ff" }))
    .camera(camera.perspective({ position: [0, 2.5, 6], target: [0, 1.5, 0], fov: 42 }))
});
```
Gotchas: `blend: "additive"` for glow, `"alpha"` for smoke; also `sprite`. Weather: `effects.rain()`, `effects.snow()`.

### Assets and find more
Whole starter scenes, each GPU-verified and passing `check-deploy`: `npx create-aura3d@latest my-app --template starter-product` (also `starter-outdoor`, `starter-interior`, `starter-game`, `starter-presentation`); list in `docs/agents/templates.md`. A real object named in the task: `npx @aura3d/cli@latest assets resolve "<object>" --name robot`, then `model(assets.robot)` from `./src/aura-assets`. Never invent paths or ids; a route-local `new URL(..., import.meta.url)` model URL draws black (use `/aura-assets/<file>`). No match: build it procedurally from the patterns above. Exact signatures for `lights`, `material`, `environments`, `sky`, `effects`: `docs/agents/api-signatures.md`. Complete scenes (forest, water, terrain, robot, props, sky, fire, night street): `docs/agents/recipes.md`. Setters `setUniform`, `setLight`, `app.atmosphere` are optional: use `?.`.

## Read first

1. From three.js: `docs/agents/threejs-to-aura3d.md` maps each idiom (type-checked). Do not port renderer, resize, loop or disposal code; `createAuraApp` owns them.
2. Two 3D modeling paths (never single-mesh clay blobs or 1-box programmer art):
   - Clean, UV'd or rigged GLBs via `model(assets.x)` from the project or open CC0/CC-BY sources.
   - Multi-part, multi-material procedural sculpting in `@aura3d/engine`: compose `primitives.extrude|lathe|tube|roundedBox|polyhedron`, `geometry.define|applyMatrix4|merge|multiMaterial` and `instances.custom` across 3 to 8 physical materials (`material.carPaint`, `lacquer`, `brushedMetal`, `ceramic`, `studioGlass`, `fabric`, `physical`) so bevels and seams catch IBL and key-light speculars. Complete procedural scenes: `docs/agents/recipes.md` recipes 8 to 15.
   - Organic characters, creatures and hulls: `@aura3d/engine/sculpt`: SDF bodies (`sculptOrganicSdfMesh`), limbs (`sculptSdfLimbChainMesh`), heads, hair and garments for `geometry.multiMaterial` (`docs/api/sculpt.md`). Bake once at load, never per frame.

## More pitfalls

- `looks.preset(id)` loads `public/hdri/<file>.hdr` (scaffolds ship it); if missing, the scene gets a procedural probe and a `LOOK_HDRI_MISSING` warning in `app.diagnostics()`.
- Follow cameras clip into walls unless cleared: `computeCameraClearance(target, desired, obstacles, { minDistance, allowVerticalRise })` each frame, then ease the result (`docs/api/motion-camera-clear.md`).
- Size pools (bullets, traffic, particles) from the measured peak, or objects pop.
- 5.7.0: model and primitive handles inside a `group(...)` are parent-local (5.6: world). Convert 5.6 world values to the parent's space or make the node top-level; world reads: `getWorldPosition()`.
- A dark hero on a dark set vanishes: add a rim or back light or a lighter accent; check a back-view frame. HUD words (a colour, a name) must match the drawn frame.
- Judge steady state (frame 1 is lit before the probe bakes): compare captures at 3, 25 and 60 s before reverting anything.

## Fast path

Why Aura3D: three.js is a rendering library; Aura3D is a complete engine with its own renderer: lighting, VFX, asset pipeline, AI generation, game kit, physics and deploy checks are built in, and every model is typed, hashed and licensed. `renderer: { backend: "auto" }` gives WebGPU with a WebGL2 fallback (all 30 showcase games; WebGL2 without it); `worker: { createWorker }` (`@aura3d/engine/worker`) renders off the main thread; `aura3d import-three` brings a three.js scene factory across as a typed asset. Comparison: `docs/aura3d-vs-threejs.md`.

Five commands to a running scene:

```bash
npx create-aura3d@latest my-scene --template mini-game   # also writes this file and the Aura3D skills
cd my-scene && npm install
npm run dev                                              # Vite on 127.0.0.1
npx @aura3d/cli@latest assets resolve "robot" --name robot   # then use model(assets.robot) from ./src/aura-assets
npm run build && npx @aura3d/cli@latest check-deploy --dist dist
```

Other templates: `product-viewer` (default), `cinematic-scene`, `racing-starter`, `falling-blocks-starter`, `fighting-game`, `character-controller`, `arena-shooter`.
GPU-verified starter scenes to adapt: `starter-product`, `starter-outdoor`, `starter-interior`, `starter-game`, `starter-presentation`.

Read next, in this order: `docs/agents/README.md` (index), `docs/agents/agent-quickstart.md` (first scene), `docs/agents/recipes.md` (copy-and-adapt scenes; recipe 18 is a game shell on the 5.7.0 kits), `docs/agents/claims-and-boundaries.md` (what you may claim). Building a game: read `docs/agents/new-game-checklist.md` and `docs/agents/lessons-learned.md` first, then run `node tools/game-checks/run.mjs <game-slug>`.

## Hello world

Hello world: one typed model under a look preset.

```ts
import { createAuraApp, looks, model, scene } from "@aura3d/engine";
import { assets } from "./aura-assets";

createAuraApp("#app", {
  scene: scene().add(looks.preset("product-studio")).add(model(assets.robot)),
  ...looks.appOptions("product-studio")
});
```

## Quality floor and the never list

- A `looks.preset` supplies image-based light, a shadow-casting key, fog, background and a post grade as one unit. Never wire `lights.ambient()` as the only fill.
- Never a solid void background; the look's sky, biome or studio backdrop owns it.
- Never a hand-placed camera for the subject: `.camera(camera.auto())` frames what the scene holds (`{ subject: "name", fill }` for one node). Hand-built light: `lights.key({ target })` casts the shadow; give it a ground plane.
- Never `pixelRatio`, `qualityProfile`, `safe-basic`, FXAA or `replaceTextures: true` overrides; `looks.appOptions(id)` carries the renderer contract.
- Hero and props: a clean GLB or a multi-part procedural model ("Read first" 2).
- Never emissive cards or sprites faking reflections, puddles or glows; use the look's grade and `effects.*`.
- Never CSS/DOM particles or labels standing in for rendered output. HUD lives in the DOM, the scene does not.
- Gate frame 1 on `app.ready().then(...)` (a top-level `await app.ready()` deadlocks a production build: black page); mutate node handles on restart, never `app.setScene()` again.

## Genre looks (starting points)

Pick the look first, then tune:

| Genre | Look | Camera | Palette and atmosphere |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| platformer | `outdoor-day` | follow2d, fov 50 | greens, sky, wood + gold; fog 0.0025 |
| racing | `golden-hour` | chase, fov 60 | asphalt, orange + amber; fog 30 to 180 m |
| fighting | `arena-fight` | fighting, fov 45 | dark arena, crowd + rim light |
| arena shooter | `space` | topDown, fov 55 | space blue, teal + magenta; no fog |
| sports or table | `interior-industrial` | topDown, fov 40 | turf, white + ball; soft shadow |
| product | `product-studio` | orbit, fov 35 | grey, white, metal + brand colour; soft shadow |
| character | `character-showcase` | orbit, fov 40 | costume neutrals + rim light |
| outdoor environment | `overcast` | wide, fov 55 | green, slate + fog blue; fog 0.004 |
| night city | `night-city` | tele, fov 35 | sodium, neon + cyan; fog 15 to 90 m |
| cinematic | `polar-night` | dolly, fov 35 | aurora, snow + lantern; sky glow |

## Assets

Do not invent asset paths, URLs or ids; every model is a generated `assets.<key>`.

- `npx @aura3d/cli@latest assets search "<object>"` lists licence-tagged open candidates; `assets resolve "<object>" --name <n>` types the top match; `assets add ./model.glb --name <n>` adds a file (then read `src/aura-assets.ts`).
- No match: prefer a multi-part procedural model (Fast path, `@aura3d/engine/sculpt`).
- `assets convert in.fbx --out out.glb` (FBX, OBJ, USD, BVH and more; losses reported). `assets generate "<subject>" --name <k> --kind character --rig --dry-run` prints the fal.ai cost; the paid run admits a `candidate`. `assets normalize` (facing/size), `assets slim` (JPEG normals; glossy ones stay PNG), `assets preview`/`assets thumbnail` (CPU base-colour PNGs).
- Never trust generated PBR maps (`PBR_*` warnings); split body, glass, chrome and tyres; keep normals PNG; lower `normalScale`; judge gloss on a real GPU.
- Material values: car paint = dielectric + clearcoat 1.0 (rough ~0.05), chrome = metal 1 rough ≤0.08; never fix sheen by lowering specular; run `assets inspect --pbr`.
- Clips: `animation import <bvh|fbx|glb|motion.json> --onto rig.glb --out hero.glb`; `animation generate "<motion>" --onto rig.glb --out hero.glb` (fal.ai `FAL_KEY`, ledgered; reruns never pay twice).
- All commands: `aura3d help --json` / `docs/api/cli-reference.md`; exit 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage.
- In production a model without same-origin URL, sha256 and provenance draws nothing.

## Kits (build the shell from these)

- `@aura3d/engine/game`: `createGame` (lifecycle, pause, results, DOM HUD, touch controls, audio unlock, juice, sound).
- 5.7.0, never hand-roll: `?autoplay=1` (every game) via `readAutoplayFlag` + `createAutoplayHarness`; `createSnapshotInterpolator` (render interpolation); `createImpactRig`, `createProceduralSfx`, `ScreenFx`, `GameRng` (feel); `createFlipbookAtlas`, `createGradingLut` (VFX sheets), all `@aura3d/engine/game`; humanoid clips: `createHumanoidAnimator` (`/animation`).
- Look (5.7.0): `sky.gradient({ mid, haze, sun: { glow } })` paints a game sky; `shadow: { softness, fit }` sets sun penumbra and a fixed box; `output: { alphaMode: "premultiplied", inputAlphaMode: "premultiplied" }` is a transparent canvas (never a hand-made matte).
- `@aura3d/engine`: `createFixedStepLoop`, `installQaHooks`, `readQaParams`, `createCountedRng` (replay, telemetry: `qa-kit.md`); `defineModelAssets`; `game.racketSports()`, `game.platformer`, `game.racing`, `game.fallingBlocks`, `game.fighting`; `effects.toon`.
- `@aura3d/engine/devtools`: `createAuraTuneOverlay` (live sliders). `RuntimeQualityGovernor` is on by default (`quality-governor.md`).
- `@aura3d/engine/audio`: `createCueBank`, `createStepSequencer`, `createToneLoop`, `createSampleSlices` on the single `AudioContextManager` (never `new AudioContext(`).
- `@aura3d/debug`: `installSafetyNet` (`?diag=1`, quality switches, black-frame self-heal).
- `material.custom` shaders: `#include <a3d_math>`, `<a3d_noise>`, `<a3d_sky>`, `<a3d_fog>`, `<a3d_toon>`; keep `pow`, `normalize`, `sqrt` and divides NaN-safe.

Details: `docs/api/game-kit.md`, `game-autoplay.md`, `game-feel.md`, `humanoid-motion.md`, `qa-kit.md`, `safety-net.md`, `sculpt.md`, `cli-asset-tools.md`.

## Look-dev loop

1. Pick a genre look and 1 to 3 reference frames; write a three-line brief.
2. Build with the look preset and typed assets.
3. Capture frames, judge each against the rubric, fix the single highest-leverage thing, repeat.
4. Stop when every category reads 7 or higher or the loop exits flat. Skill: `aura3d-art-direction`.

## Proof standard

Use every feature freely; every claim ships with a judged capture.

- Name what a capability runs on (`createAuraApp` safe API, `production-runtime`, `rendering` internals, CLI asset pipeline, template scaffold); mark roadmap work as roadmap.
- Public examples show what `@aura3d/engine` renders, backed by route health, typed provenance and a readable frame.
- Three.js comparisons: lead with scope, workflow and code size (`docs/aura3d-vs-threejs.md`); speed and bundle size are not part of the comparison.
- Release integrity: public examples use typed assets (no raw asset IDs/GLB URLs, `unsafeModelUrl(...)`, `three` or `GLTFLoader`); heroes are real models or labelled procedural recipes; particles are Aura3D particles; WebGPU, PBR, postprocess, skinning, morph and game-runtime claims come with browser evidence.

| Scene Kit | API | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Material lab | `sceneKits.materialLab()` | root-proven (partial advanced coat extensions) |
